'''Morag's potion''' was a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] mixture created by [[Morag]], the [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]]. With this dark, opaque liquid, Morag intended to poison the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]' [[Berry/Legends|berry]] bushes with it so they would starve to [[Death/Legends|death]]. The witch enlisted the services of her pet [[Condor dragon/Legends|mantigrue]] to spread the poison throughout the forest, covering the bushes with a thick, wooly fog. However, the Ewok [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] created [[Logray's antidote|another potion]] that had the double effect of disinfecting the berries and making them toxic to Morag only.<ref name="Perfect Antidote" />
